location_name: Alison, Collins, East, Landsdowne, Petley Reefs; Amboyna Cay, Grierson Reef, West Reef; Barque Canada Reef (Truong Sa / Spratly Islands)
summary: AMTI reported that since the start of 2025 Vietnam had begun dredging and landfill at eight more Spratly features (Alison, Collins, East, Landsdowne and Petley Reefs plus Amboyna Cay, Grierson and West Reefs), so that all 21 Vietnamese-held rocks and low-tide elevations now carried artificial land, and had built munitions depots and identical building complexes on its expanded reefs.
actors: Vietnamese government / Vietnam People's Navy (dredging, landfill, construction)
reasoning: Extending reclamation to every remaining outpost and adding military storage is demonstrative construction of wider scope (new features). Dated by AMTI's 22 August 2025 report covering January-August imagery. China protested on 25 August.

sources.title: No Islet Left Behind: Vietnam Reclaims Land at Every Remaining Spratly Outpost
sources.excerpt: Since the start of 2025, Vietnam has expanded its island-building efforts to eight features previously untouched by the current round of reclamation that Hanoi began in 2021.

location_name: Vietnam (domestic market and media regulation)
summary: Vietnamese authorities repeatedly acted against products and media showing China's 'nine-dash line': in March 2025 the Ministry of Industry and Trade's market-management department ordered stricter inspections and penalties after Baby Three dolls were found with line-like imagery, Ho Chi Minh City's culture department and police investigated the Chagee milk-tea brand, and in October the Cinema Department sought the removal of the Chinese drama Let Me Shine.
actors: Ministry of Industry and Trade (Department of Market Management); HCMC Department of Culture and Sports and police; Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism (Cinema Department)
reasoning: Domestic regulatory enforcement against depictions of China's claim line is an administrative assertion of Vietnam's claim; demonstrative (declarative is the alternative). Recurring practice, summarised as one event for 2025 with three instances.

sources.title: Vietnam intensifies crackdown on Baby Three dolls amid sovereignty concerns
sources.excerpt: The Department of Market Management and Domestic Trade Development has ordered stricter inspections and penalties for any violations

location_name: Truong Sa (Spratly) archipelago and DK1 platforms

actors: Vietnam People's Navy; civil-sector delegations
reasoning: State-organised civilian visits to occupied features, with flag-raising ceremonies, assert administration; demonstrative. Annual routine, one event for the season with the planned count (27 trips).

location_name: Hoai An Rock, Tri Le Reef and Cai Vung Reef (Sandy Cay), Thi Tu cluster, Truong Sa (Spratly) archipelago

actors: Ministry of Foreign Affairs; spokesperson Pham Thu Hang
reasoning: Diplomatic protest notes to two other claimants over landings on Spratly features are a formal verbal assertion; declarative. A step up from the March 2024 press-briefing-only response on the same features.

sources.title: Vietnam protests violations of its sovereignty in Truong Sa archipelago

location_name: Hoang Sa (Paracel) and Truong Sa (Spratly) archipelagos; East Sea

location_name: Hoang Sa (Paracel) Islands; Vietnamese waters

reasoning: A protest note and public rejection of a Chinese administrative measure over claimed waters is a verbal assertion; declarative. Annual routine repeat, this year with a diplomatic note.

sources.title: Vietnam protests China's fishing ban in East Sea

location_name: Hoang Sa special zone (Da Nang); Truong Sa special zone (Khanh Hoa)
summary: Under the National Assembly Standing Committee's resolutions of 16 June 2025 reorganising commune-level units, Vietnam's island districts were converted into 'special zones' (dac khu), including Hoang Sa under Da Nang and Truong Sa under Khanh Hoa, with the new units operating from 1 July 2025.
actors: National Assembly Standing Committee; Da Nang and Khanh Hoa authorities
reasoning: Re-designating the administrative units for the Paracels and Spratlys is a domestic administrative assertion (declarative legislation; demonstrative is the alternative). Part of a nationwide reform, not targeted, but changes the legal status of the claimed archipelagos' governing units.

sources.title: Party cell of Hoang Sa special zone to officially operate from July 1

location_name: Barque Canada Reef and smaller Spratly features (Truong Sa / Spratly Islands)

actors: Vietnamese government / Vietnam People's Navy (dredging, construction)
reasoning: Continued reclamation and installation of aviation infrastructure for the new Barque Canada runway is demonstrative construction. Dated to the second half of 2025 from AMTI's 8 May 2026 report; distinct from the April-May 2026 harbour work entered for 2026.

sources.title: Keeping Score: Vietnam's Spratly Island Overhaul Continues
sources.excerpt: Construction began in August 2025 and appears to have been completed by April 2026.

location_name: Vietnam's exclusive economic zone and continental shelf

actors: Ministry of Foreign Affairs; spokesperson Pham Thu Hang
reasoning: A public objection to an unauthorised Chinese survey in claimed waters is a verbal assertion; declarative. Muted in tone (RFA had reported Hanoi's media silence in June).

sources.title: Vietnamese authorities keep close watch on developments in East Sea: Spokeswoman
sources.excerpt: All research and survey activities of foreign countries conducted in Vietnam’s exclusive economic zone and continental shelf

location_name: East Sea (South China Sea)
summary: On the ninth anniversary of the 2016 South China Sea arbitral award, spokesperson Pham Thu Hang said maritime claims must be consistent with UNCLOS and that countries must fully respect coastal states' sovereignty, sovereign rights and jurisdiction established under it.
actors: Ministry of Foreign Affairs; spokesperson Pham Thu Hang
reasoning: An anniversary statement implicitly rejecting claims not based on UNCLOS (China's) is a mild verbal assertion; declarative, low weight. Vietnam had made such statements only in 2016, 2021 and 2023.

sources.title: Maritime claims must be consistent with provisions of UNCLOS 1982
sources.excerpt: Countries must fully respect the sovereignty, sovereign rights, and jurisdiction of coastal states as established in accordance with the UNCLOS, she emphasized./.

location_name: Thi Tu (Thitu) Island, Truong Sa (Spratly) archipelago
summary: Asked about the 12 October incident between Chinese and Philippine government vessels in the territorial waters of Thi Tu (Thitu) Island, spokesperson Pham Thu Hang requested the parties concerned to respect Vietnam's sovereignty over Truong Sa, including Thi Tu Island, and to exercise restraint.
actors: Ministry of Foreign Affairs; spokesperson Pham Thu Hang
reasoning: A public claim to a Philippine-held feature in response to a China-Philippines clash is a verbal assertion of sovereignty; declarative.

sources.title: Viet Nam calls on parties involved to respect its sovereignty over Truong Sa
sources.excerpt: Pham reaffirmed that Viet Nam has a solid historical and legal basis to assert its sovereignty over Truong Sa, including Thi Tu Island.

location_name: Hoang Sa (Paracel) and Truong Sa (Spratly) archipelagos
summary: After the opening ceremony of the 33rd SEA Games in Thailand on 9 December showed a map of Vietnam without the Hoang Sa and Truong Sa archipelagos, spokesperson Pham Thu Hang said Vietnamese authorities were working with the organisers to correct it and that Vietnam firmly asserted its undisputed sovereignty over both archipelagos; the organisers later apologised.
actors: Ministry of Foreign Affairs; spokesperson Pham Thu Hang
reasoning: A sovereignty assertion over the Paracels and Spratlys aimed at a non-claimant's map, which the method counts because it asserts sovereignty over the archipelagos; declarative, low weight. No claimant is targeted, so VA.

sources.title: Vietnam responds to map error omitting islands at SEA Games 33
sources.excerpt: "Once again, Vietnam firmly asserts its undisputed sovereignty over the Hoang Sa and Truong Sa archipelagos in accordance with international law," she emphasized.

location_name: Phu Lam (Woody) Island, Hoang Sa (Paracel) Islands

actors: Ministry of Foreign Affairs; spokesperson Pham Thu Hang
reasoning: A public protest at Chinese civil administration in the Paracels is a verbal assertion of sovereignty; declarative.

location_name: Truong Sa Special Zone waters (Spratly Islands)
summary: A Coast Guard Region 3 command delegation sailed on Fisheries Surveillance vessel KN 466 to inspect combat readiness and anti-IUU enforcement of the Coast Guard vessels, permanent Maritime Militia vessels and Fisheries Surveillance Squadron No. 4 ships on duty in the designated waters of the Truong Sa Special Zone.
actors: Vietnam Coast Guard Region 3; Fisheries Surveillance Squadron No. 4; permanent Maritime Militia

location_name: Vietnam (film and television distribution)
summary: The Cinema Department of the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism flagged the Chinese series Tree of Life for showing the 'nine-dash line' in its trailer, the third Chinese series it had flagged in three months (after Let Me Shine and Brilliant as the Sun), restated that Vietnam tolerates no depiction of the line, and the ministry launched a formal inspection of foreign, especially Chinese, films distributed online.
actors: Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism (Cinema Department)
reasoning: Domestic regulatory enforcement against depictions of China's claim line is an administrative assertion of Vietnam's claim; demonstrative (domestic administration), declarative is the alternative. Recurring practice, summarised for early 2026.

sources.title: Tree of Life under fire in Vietnam for illegal maritime map in trailer
sources.excerpt: In response, the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism has launched a formal inspection of foreign films distributed online, especially those originating from China.

location_name: Truong Sa (Spratly) Special Zone
summary: Vietnam held voting for the 2026-31 National Assembly and People's Councils in the Truong Sa Special Zone, with early voting at 20 polling stations across the Spratly islands on 8 March ahead of the 15 March national election day.
actors: Truong Sa Special Zone People's Committee; election committee
reasoning: Holding national elections on occupied Spratly features is unilateral administration; demonstrative. Routine every five years (the last in 2021), the first under the special-zone status.

sources.title: Vietnam's Truong Sa ready for national election
sources.excerpt: Early voting took place at 20 polling stations across islands in the Truong Sa archipelago on March 8, one week ahead of the nationwide election.

location_name: Hai Sam (Antelope) Reef, Hoang Sa (Paracel) Islands

actors: Ministry of Foreign Affairs; spokesperson Pham Thu Hang
reasoning: A public protest with diplomatic representations against Chinese island-building in the Paracels is a verbal assertion; declarative. China rejected it on 23 March.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Viet Nam
sources.excerpt: Any foreign activities conducted in Hoang Sa, including Hai Sam reef, without VietNam's permission are completely illegal and invalid.

location_name: Grierson, Petley, South and Landsdowne Reefs (Truong Sa / Spratly Islands)
summary: AMTI reported that satellite imagery of April-May 2026 showed three new harbours taking shape at Grierson, Petley and South Reefs, bringing Vietnam's Spratly harbours to 15, with another likely harbour begun at Landsdowne Reef, while landfill continued at several smaller features.
actors: Vietnamese government / Vietnam People's Navy (construction)
reasoning: Harbour construction on occupied features is demonstrative construction; dated by AMTI's 8 May 2026 report and its imagery of 10 April-3 May 2026.

sources.title: Keeping Score: Vietnam's Spratly Island Overhaul Continues

actors: State Committee for Overseas Vietnamese; Vietnam Fisheries Surveillance (KN-490); Vietnam People's Navy
reasoning: State-organised civilian and diaspora visits to occupied features assert administration; demonstrative. Annual routine; one event for the 2026 season.

location_name: Ba Binh (Itu Aba / Taiping) Island, Truong Sa (Spratly) archipelago

actors: Ministry of Foreign Affairs; spokesperson Pham Thu Hang
reasoning: A public protest against Taiwanese exercises on a Spratly feature is a verbal assertion; declarative. First such protest of Taiwan found in this period (the last was August 2023).

reasoning: An anniversary statement implicitly rejecting China's non-UNCLOS claims is a verbal assertion; declarative. Stronger wording than the 2025 statement (UNCLOS as 'sole legal basis').
